high_level_description: This black-and-white photograph depicts the exterior of a clothing store in Copenhagen, Denmark, from 1936. The building is covered entirely with rows upon rows of hanging garments, primarily shirts, creating a striking visual effect. The shirts are neatly arranged and appear to be displayed for sale. The store's name, "Chr. Troelstrup," is prominently displayed on a signboard at the bottom left corner of the building. The sign also includes some smaller text that is not clearly legible in the image. In front of the store, there are a few people engaged in various activities.
